about: Simulated wild bet queue for the Bombas demo, seeded in round 0 on 2026-09-27. Nothing here is a Bombas plan or result. Each bet points at a brain record (why it exists), claim records that must be tier approved or site_backed (what it may say), and one room metric it would move. The 8 bound fields gate a bet before it can move to executing.

bets.title: A wall of 200 million pairs at the West Village store
bets.idea: A pop-up wall inside the New York store that counts donations live, one light per 1,000 pairs, with a Giving Partner on site each Saturday.

bets.title: World Homeless Day drop with Giving Partners in 50 states
bets.idea: On 10 October, one Giving Partner per state hands out pairs on the same morning. Press gets a map of all 50 drops.
bets.downside_limit: Stop at $40,000 or if fewer than 30 partners confirm by 3 October.
bets.control_design: Matched-market: 10 states with a drop and no paid push against 10 similar states with neither.
bets.cohort: Shoppers in the 20 test and control states, direct and referral visits.
bets.stop_rule: Kill if placements are under 5 by 17 October.
bets.bound: At most $40,000 and 1 staff week. No new claim beyond the donation pledge and the partner count.

bets.title: B Corp open books: the impact report as a press story
bets.idea: Publish the B Impact score line by line with what it cost, and pitch it as the story of a sock brand that shows its work.
bets.downside_limit: Stop at $15,000 or 2 weeks of one writer's time.
bets.cohort: Business and sustainability press list, 40 contacts.
bets.stop_rule: Kill if no outlet commits within 21 days of the first pitch.
bets.bound: Only facts already on the site. No score is quoted until it is on the site.

bets.title: Target aisle giving tag with a scan-to-see-your-donation page
bets.idea: A shelf tag in the Target sock aisle links to a page that shows the donation each pair made, tied to the partner rollout.
bets.downside_limit: Stop at $25,000 or if tag scans are under 500 in 30 days.
bets.control_design: Stores with the tag against matched stores without it, same region.
bets.cohort: Target sock shoppers in 60 test and 60 control stores.
bets.stop_rule: Kill if scans per store are under 8 at day 30.
bets.bound: At most $25,000. Tag copy uses only the donation pledge.

bets.title: Happiness Guarantee swap day
bets.idea: One Saturday a year, bring any worn-out pair of socks to a Bombas store and walk out with a new pair under the guarantee. The old pairs go to textile recycling.
